title: Primitive-ray q-dispersion for the canonical M2 density--discrepancy core

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only and audit literal moving-symbol, parity, support, and endpoint hypotheses before any source import.

frozen_target.question: Can exact cross-ray differencing in q=(b-a)/2, using chi_4(a)chi_4(b)=(-1)^q before density/discrepancy separation, supply the full rho^(-1/2) gain for the canonical hard M2 block?
frozen_target.reference_formula: sum_(A,D,K,G,R)|Q_(A,D,K,G,R)| <<_epsilon L^2 X^epsilon, where positive block capacity is L^2 X^epsilon sqrt(rho) and rho=AJD^3/L^3.
scope: retain the complete actual coefficient and moving k interval
keep metric density and discrepancy modes coupled
retain coprimality, parity, both orientations, stars, and all prior owners

completion_criteria: Derive the exact m,q lattice, character, and q-shift correlation.
Audit moving reciprocal endpoints and the complete actual symbol.
Retain density and discrepancy jointly through every norm inequality.
Prove rho^(-1/2), a target-safe nonempty hard subrange, or an exact self-return/no-go.
Audit square, exact-centre, Pell, fourth-power, and short-q controls.
Complete clean blind, analytic, and hostile/source reports.
Make one conductor decision without advancing to another round.

tasks.target: Independently derive and test the complete q-shift dispersion mechanism.
Prove the canonical bound, a target-safe hard subrange, or an exact equal-capacity return from actual-symbol q-dispersion.
Falsify unsupported q-dispersion gains and audit current theorem applicability.

review_seams.requirement: Check m,q,k,u,Lambda,rho and the L^2 target exactly.
Keep the complete actual symbol and density/discrepancy coefficient coupled.
Check every q-shift support, parity, gcd, endpoint, and owner boundary.
Measure the actual rho power before and after differencing.
Test short-q, Pell, square, exact-centre, fourth-power, and false unsigned cases.
Audit literal hypotheses of every proposed external theorem.
Separate the canonical cone from other M2 packets, M9, and the target.

closing_assessment.main_result: Legal fixed-m q-shifts erase the character, coefficientwise or diagonal-separated one-step bounds gain at most D^(-1/2), and shift plus reciprocal transforms return at equal capacity. The complete fixed-a actual Gram remains open; no hard subrange, canonical M2 theorem, or exponent is promoted.
